summary: Spec for climb-recording share SEO (X/TikTok/YouTube): canonical /r/{id} for persisted ClimbRun rows with replay_token; unique OG/Twitter cards; standalone share-payload JSON aligned to PR #11 draft fields without requiring that branch; ShareRun+dashboard actions for all three platforms with UNSUPPORTED_BY_PLATFORM for TikTok/YouTube compose; robots/sitemap/JSON-LD WebPage; TikTok/ByteDance bot UAs; ASCENT OG restyle; additive runId on climb/result. 12 stories, AC-1–AC-40. Not blocked — ADR assumptions A-1–A-13. F-1 score trust left open.
goal: SEO for sharing climb-recording links on X, TikTok, and YouTube so a marketing agent can post them and crawlers unfurl a unique preview (title, description, image, canonical URL) per recording.

learnings.insight: The free-leaderboard trust-boundary ping (F-1 / climb peakY) is explicitly out of scope for recording-share SEO. Cards display persisted peak_y as untrusted display text. This spec does not close F-1 and does not add AC-17 re-sim.
learnings.action: Do not attach server-derived peak requirements to /r/{id} OG or share payload. Leave F-1 open. Cite A-8 if a review finding claims this change authenticates scores.

learnings.insight: PR #11 (origin/cursor/ai-social-media-agent-133a) defines PLATFORM_CAPTION_LIMITS TIKTOK 2200 / X 280 / YOUTUBE 5000, YouTube title slice 100, draft fields title/caption/description/hashtags/cta, and compose failures as UNSUPPORTED_BY_PLATFORM. That branch must not be required to merge. YouTube publish currently silently .slice(0,100) titles — our builder must never emit title > 100 so we do not depend on that slice.
learnings.action: Design a standalone share-payload builder in this repo (no social Prisma import). Mirror field names and JS .length limits. Return VALIDATION_ERROR rather than slice. X compose is twitter/x intent; TikTok and YouTube compose.mode is UNSUPPORTED_BY_PLATFORM.

learnings.insight: POST /api/climb/result and recordClimb do not return ClimbRun.id today, so the client cannot build /r/{id} after save. Anonymous path must stay {saved:false, reason:anonymous} with no runId. Dashboard still copies /play?r=token via window.location.origin.
learnings.action: Add runId additively to recordClimb and the saved:true JSON. Point ShareRun and ClimbReplaysSection at the canonical URL builder using resolveBaseUrl()/PUBLIC_CONFIG.siteUrl, never request Host, never window.location.origin for marketing canonicals.

learnings.insight: Middleware already forwards INTERNAL_TOKEN to request.nextUrl.origin (trust.md #4). Listing OG query params are attacker-controlled strings. Short /r/{id} ids are enumerable unlike unguessable replay tokens. Share JSON could leak replay_token/seed/email if the page loader reuses the DB row wholesale.
learnings.action: Canonical/OG/share URL builders take an explicit origin from resolveBaseUrl()/PUBLIC_CONFIG.siteUrl — do not copy middleware's Host-derived fetch. Sanitize OG display params (length-cap, strip markup, never 500). 404 unknown ids; omit replay_token, seed, and email from the payload. Do not sitemap /r/.

learnings.insight: loop/spec.md AC-1–AC-40 are written to invoke production units (builders, POST handler, isBot, runViewPipeline, robots/sitemap/JSON-LD, OG width/height + palette constants). Dual bot lists (botList.ts vs middleware BOT_PATTERNS) will make AC-38 pass and AC-39 fail if only one list is updated. Bytespider already matches generic 'spider' today — tests must use explicit tiktok/bytespider/bytedance fixtures so removal of 'spider' cannot drop TikTok.
learnings.action: Export one isBot implementation and call it from middleware. Tests import builders/handlers and assert output; do not grep route.tsx for #0ea5e9 or DESIGN.md hexes. Prove over-limit captions with a 281-char fixture that is not sliced (AC-17).

learnings.insight: qa-acceptance 2026-08-30 noted loop/spec.md missing and stale landing AC-27/AC-32. This spec is recording-share SEO, not a landing-grid rewrite. Homepage OG restyle uses DESIGN void #0a0a0c (not #0a0a0f, not sky-blue #0ea5e9).
learnings.action: Do not fail this change for featured-grid count comments on app/app/page.tsx. When the landing spec is rewritten, set grid to FEATURED_GAME_CATEGORIES.length and background to void #0a0a0c. QA this change against AC-1–AC-40 in loop/spec.md.

learnings.insight: Spec records 12 stories, AC-1–AC-40, 13 ADR assumptions, 11 risks. Primary URL: /r/{recordingId}. OG: 1200×630 landscape + 1080×1080 square. Limits: X 280 including URL, TikTok 2200, YouTube title 100 / description 5000. Production origin https://www.doomstack.lol.
learnings.action: Architect: implement contracts in loop/spec.md; do not widen to MP4, oEmbed, player cards, Instagram, or F-1 re-sim.
